title: Change an item
prompt: Replace the second item of the array with value, then return the array. [1, 2, 3] with 9 becomes [1, 9, 3].
hints: You can assign to a position the same way you read from it.

docs.name: list[i]
docs.what: The item at position i. Positions start at 0; -1 is the last item.
